markReady.q: When should I mark an order as ready?
markReady.a: As soon as the food is packed. Open the order and tap "Mark as ready for pickup" — the driver is told right away, so they don't wait at your counter.

soldOut.q: How do I stop orders for a dish that's sold out?
soldOut.a: Go to Menu and switch the dish off. Customers will see it as sold out until you switch it back on — nothing is deleted.

scheduled.a: Customers can ask for delivery at a later time. You'll get a pop-up to accept or reject, and every request is listed under Scheduled orders.

pickupCode.a: Each order has a code the driver must tell you at pickup. Hand the order only to a driver who gives the code shown on the order.

payouts.a: Open Payouts from the dashboard to see your balance and withdraw it to the bank account verified during onboarding. Raise a ticket under "Payments & payouts" for any payout question.

password.q: I forgot my password. What now?
password.a: Tap "Forgot password?" on the sign-in screen. We'll email a 6-digit code to your registered address so you can set a new one.
